newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR TRADER KOPEX.
newsitem.headline: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR TRADER KOPEX.

text.p: The Polish Treasury Ministry has invited bids for not less than 10 percent of shares in trader Kopex SA, the ministry said in a statement on Wednesday.
The ministry said bids must be submitted by August 27.
It said 10 percent of Kopex shares would be granted to pension funds in the reform of the social security system, 15 percent to employees and five percent to restitution claims.
The ministry said investors deemed worthy of continuing the bidding process would have until September 26 to update their offers.
